reigns.note: Aeolid founder who married Tyro and begot Aeson, Amythaon, and Pheres.
Son of Poseidon and Tyro, who seized Iolcus and sent Jason after the Golden Fleece when the oracle warned of the man with one sandal.
Rightful heir dispossessed by Pelias, father of Jason, whom the usurper kept from the throne.
Returned from Colchis with the fleece and Medea; in Apollodorus' account he succeeds after Pelias' death.
Son of Pelias who buried his father and expelled Jason and Medea; ruled Iolcus after the cauldron.
